name: ahura-data-runner
description: AhuraCloud data runner (RAG connectors). Polls inference.connectors for queued syncs, atomically claims each, lists the source (S3 / web-crawl), and incrementally ingests it into the bound vector collection (fetch → extract → chunk → batch-embed → upsert, with content-hash/ETag skip + tombstone deletion). Runs as a single-replica k8s Deployment. Doc: nextstespsAI/20-rag-connectors-and-data-runner.md.
